Hi Siva — quick update ahead of SOW: 

- Attached is the pre-read matrix (pasted below as link + summary). It covers throughput/latency expectations, typical cost delta (hosted vs dedicated vs private), and recommended QuickStart for SI teams. Pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-consultlytics-bootcamp

Summary (TL;DR):
- Hosted API: fastest time-to-value, good for POCs; limited control over private network constraints.
- Dedicated: predictable throughput, best if you have sustained volume; supports GPU pools and reserved scaling.
- Private: required for regulated workloads; more ops overhead but full network control and KMS/HSM integrations.

Prep checklist for Nov 30:
- Confirm final attendee list by Nov 24 (Siva)
- Ensure partner portal invites sent (Hannah) — temporary role: "SI-bootcamp-participant"
- Updated SOW redline (Stephanie) by EOD Nov 20 — once accepted we schedule the calendar invite

Also adding a short lab note: we'll run a live model routing demo; to avoid data exposure we'll use synthetic datasets and masked prompts — Laura will send the two-line SOC2 guidance.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
